info.name: BFF Project integration tests
info.description: MAIR-262: working checks (the BFF starts, reaches Project API and Core API, resolves the caller from the Bearer JWT) and the project journey the Projects front relies on (templates, project creation and reading, task statuses, tasks, collaboration, archiving, duplication, closing, deletion), replayed by newman on docker-compose-integration.yml (./integration_test.sh). The seeded Admin (user 1) and agent (user 2) are impersonated with JWTs forged from the JWT_SECRET of the stack; every row the collection creates is deleted at the end so it stays replayable.

exec: // One fresh account per run so the collection is replayable against a persistent database.
// The seeded accounts have no known password: forge their JWT exactly like mairie360_api_lib::jwt_manager
// does (HS256, claims { sub, role, exp }), signed with the JWT_SECRET of the stack, injected by
// docker-compose-integration.yml (random per run, MAIR-428). `role` is the claim the BFFs read (MAIR-529).
const payload = b64url(cryptoJs.enc.Utf8.parse(JSON.stringify({ sub: String(sub), role, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600 })));
